items.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995
items.q: Jon Hendricks and Joe Williams and Peggy Lee were singing with the Basie band for Ella.

ctx.x: Sometimes the younger musicians that, well like myself, I always wanted to do a big band, but I never saw the downside of it perhaps — that night after night.

It’s unfortunate that it’s so difficult as far as the demands on your physical well being, to get out there. But you’re so pumped up there from the adrenaline of meeting people and going to different places and enjoying the atmosphere of different places every night of your life, and just the admiration that you’re receiving from the audiences and everything. So it keeps you pumped up with the adrenaline but if you take more than two or three days off, if you get a week off or something, you totally collapse. So…
Well that’s a pretty good trio, actually.
